note: Committed fixtures are SYNTHETIC. The real saved pages are the collector's own likes, collection and downloads and are local-only. See README.md in this directory.

files.describes: 8 js-design-card chunks yielding 6 cards: ordinary likes cards, a downloads card, a numeric from-token that must become collection:{id}, a duplicate that must not be emitted twice, a skeleton with no data-trackid, an avatar carrying real alt text placed BEFORE the cover (the title time bomb), and a card whose only title source is the cover alt. Obfuscated mw-css-* classes are reproduced so a test can prove nothing depends on them.

A __NEXT_DATA__ payload resolved through the KNOWN PATH props.pageProps.design. Encodes: prediction in SECONDS, one rated and one unrated profile (rating null, never 0), differing needAms so printableWithoutAms is true, A1 mini declared via both compatibility.devProductName and otherCompatibility[], categories mixing an object and a string, the load-bearing productProperyList misspelling, and a for-you card summary with no instances array that the discriminator must refuse.

The site-re-templated case: props.pageProps.design is absent and the design has moved into a query cache, so the discriminated deep walk must find it and parseDetail().via must report 'deep-walk'. Carries two decoys the walk must refuse — one with no instances, one where instances is an object rather than an array.
A real saved Likes page: 733 cards, all unique, list token 'likes'.
